sample_unit: case vignettes (each run three times per model)

links.outcome: Emergency recognition and advice to call emergency services in paediatric emergency vignettes
links.effect: Both models recognized the emergency in the cases except septic shock and pulmonary embolism; reliably advised calling emergency services in only 12 of 22 cases (54%).
links.quote: However, ChatGPT/GPT-4 reliably advised to call emergency services only in 12 of 22 cases (54%), gave correct first aid instructions in 9 cases (45%) and incorrectly advised advanced life support techniques to parents in 3 of 22 cases (13.6%).

links.outcome: Recognition of safety-critical situations and escalation advice (calling emergency services)
links.effect: Missed emergency in septic shock and pulmonary embolism; advised emergency call reliably in only 54% (12 of 22) of cases.
links.quote: However, ChatGPT/GPT-4 reliably advised to call emergency services only in 12 of 22 cases (54%), gave correct first aid instructions in 9 cases (45%) and incorrectly advised advanced life support techniques to parents in 3 of 22 cases (13.6%).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT and GPT-4 performance and safety on pediatric life support vignettes, analyzing advice accuracy and safety for lay rescuers without testing a deployment practice.
